notes: Fresh 1536x1024 capture from run 34538797800 at commit a9a96a482b099c4b848a00df8ee66bb4013caf18, replacing the accepted alpha.8 record whose digest no longer describes what ships. The maintainer inspected this capture and accepted it; Claude Opus 5 (Claude Code) inspected it first and recorded this file at the maintainer's direction. The frame is materially unchanged from alpha.8's, and deliberately so: this release's one visible change is that a window of 1100 pixels or less no longer opens inside a modal review drawer over an inert queue, and this capture is 1536 wide, where the inspector has always been a side panel. That narrow behaviour is held by the 1024-pixel browser gate and by a unit test, not by this frame. Everything the accepted concept asks of the capture still holds: sidebar counts, queue table and review drawer read as three planes; the header states the privacy posture beside the brand tag; proposed filenames stay date-first with right-aligned confidence and em-dashes for absent values; Ready, Needs review, Processing and Waiting differ by icon as well as colour; evidence stays attributed under DATE, TYPE and PARTIES with each party on its own line. No clipping, collisions, illegible copy or ambiguous focus were seen, and the run's automated contrast assertions passed. The rest of the release is beneath the window: a shared folder that recovers from a teammate's crash, a local-only intake setting that is re-derived rather than trusted for ever, coordination files that survive an antivirus hold, and a settings file that reports what it could not read instead of silently starting with defaults. The sign-off is accepted only for the digest and screenshot hash above; any later change to a non-QA release input invalidates it and requires a new capture and review.
